actions.name: call stopAtWall in a forever loop

control_flow: Forever: stopAtWall: if no obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left at 10 %/40 %; else curve right at 40 %/10 %.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, and when a wall is right in front, stop before it without touching it and stay there.

an obstacle is ahead: it calls followLine
black: it curves left (left wheel 10 %, right 40 %)
no black: it curves right (left wheel 40 %, right 10 %)
